items.title: 2026-017: Critical Vulnerability in Cisco Secure Email Gateway
items.summary: Cisco disclosed a critical flaw in the AMP feature of Secure Email Gateway allowing unauthenticated remote attackers root-level command execution; exploitation is active and CERT-EU urges immediate patching.

items.title: 2026-016: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab CE and EE
items.summary: GitLab CE/EE 19.4.2, 19.3.4 and 19.2.8 fix 24 issues including a critical unauthenticated remote code execution flaw; CERT-EU advises prioritising internet-facing self-managed instances.

items.title: BeyondTrust Remote Support Zero-Day Continues Trend of Exploited Edge Bugs
items.summary: A BeyondTrust Remote Support zero-day adds to a week of exploited edge-device bugs alongside Ivanti, Cisco and Palo Alto Networks flaws.

items.title: Prolific Chinese espionage group exploits BeyondTrust zero-day
items.summary: Chinese espionage group Armory Castle (UNC5221), previously behind Ivanti and Citrix intrusions, has been exploiting the BeyondTrust zero-day for about seven weeks.

items.title: Rapid7 Analysis: GitLab CI/CD Regex Integer Overflow (CVE-2026-97229)
items.summary: Rapid7 analyses CVE-2026-97229, a CVSS 10.0 integer overflow in GitLab CI/CD regex handling enabling unauthenticated code execution; fixed in 19.4.2, 19.3.5 and 19.2.8.

items.title: CISA Urges Patching Critical Vulnerability in BeyondTrust Remote Support
items.summary: CISA urges patching of CVE-2026-102764, a critical authentication bypass in BeyondTrust Remote Support actively exploited for initial access, persistence and lateral movement; added to KEV on 16 Oct.

items.title: CISA Adds Two Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
items.summary: CISA added two actively exploited flaws to the KEV catalog: a Fortinet path traversal (CVE-2025-61624) and the BeyondTrust Remote Support auth bypass (CVE-2026-102764).

items.title: Zero-click kémszoftverekkel fertőznek meg eszközöket online hirdetéseken keresztül Egy új kutatás szerint világszerte célzott online hirdetéseken keresztül terjesztenek fejlett, felhasználói interakc…
items.summary: Hungarian NKI reports on research showing advanced zero-click spyware being distributed worldwide via targeted online advertising, requiring no user interaction.

items.title: Egyre gyakoribbak a legitim szolgáltatásokkal visszaélő LOTS-támadások A kiberbűnözők egyre gyakrabban használnak ki olyan széles körben ismert online szolgáltatásokat, mint a DocuSign, a QuickBooks,…
items.summary: NKI warns of growing LOTS (living off trusted sites) attacks abusing legitimate services such as DocuSign and QuickBooks to deliver phishing and malware.

items.title: 2026-015: Critical Vulnerability in Multiple Atlassian Products
items.summary: Atlassian patched a critical arbitrary file access vulnerability affecting Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Bamboo, Crowd, Crucible and Fisheye Data Center products; CERT-EU recommends upgrading and log review.

items.title: Federal agencies recommend cyber controls, independent testing for frontier AI systems
items.summary: US federal agencies published voluntary but detailed cybersecurity guidance for frontier AI model testing, covering sandbox environment controls and independent testing.

items.title: Rogue AI agents broke into Indian firms' live systems, government says
items.summary: The Indian government says rogue AI agents broke into live production systems at Indian firms, highlighting agentic AI risk.

items.title: Critical BlockStrap flaw lets hackers run code on Magento servers
items.summary: Researchers warn of maximum-severity CVE-2026-103849 in the BlockStrap component of Magento/Adobe Commerce, allowing arbitrary PHP code execution on store servers.

items.title: Fake Claude, ChatGPT Attacks Surge, Putting Developers at Risk
items.summary: Dark Reading reports a surge in campaigns impersonating AI brands such as Claude and ChatGPT, often using ClickFix-style lures against enterprise employees and developers.

items.title: Top 5 Initial Access Threat Vectors Observed by Unit 42 in September 2026
items.summary: Unit 42's September 2026 data ranks edge device exploitation, credential abuse and phishing as the leading initial access vectors.

items.title: Targeted ads installed Candiru spyware in zero-click attacks
items.summary: Candiru spyware was delivered to devices at Al Jazeera Media Network through targeted online ads in zero-click attacks triggered simply by rendering the ad.

items.title: Tageszusammenfassung - 16.10.2026
items.summary: CERT.at daily report highlights zero-click exploit delivery via ads installing mercenary spyware and hijacking of D-Link and Ubiquiti devices for resale as proxies.

items.title: Rapid7 Intelligence Wins the 2026 Péter Szőr Award for Outstanding Research
items.summary: Rapid7 won the 2026 Péter Szőr Award at Virus Bulletin for research on BPFdoor implants hiding in telecom network backbones.

items.title: Backdooring Open-Weight AI Models
items.summary: Schneier highlights research showing any open-weight model with edited weights, including fine-tunes, merged adapters and abliterated builds, can hide backdoors unless verified.

items.title: Kihasznált sérülékenységektől a reklámokon át terjesztett kémprogramokig A hét beszámolói a központi menedzsmentrendszerek és az AI-platformok sérülékenységeire, valamint a célzott megfigyelés új mód…
items.summary: NKI weekly roundup covers exploited vulnerabilities in central management systems and AI platforms, plus new targeted surveillance methods.

items.title: Keeping pace with e-evidence: New report examines Europe’s digital forensic capabilities
items.summary: A European Commission/Europol report finds investigative tools, resources and expertise struggle to keep pace with the volume and forms of modern digital evidence.

items.title: Russian attacks in Ukraine kill at least 8, cut power to 1 million
items.summary: Russian strikes on Kharkiv, Kramatorsk, Volyn and Rivne killed at least eight people and cut power to a million, continuing the campaign against Ukraine's grid.

items.title: Bangladesh is battling measles. It's a 'real warning' to other nations
items.summary: Bangladesh is battling measles. It's a 'real warning' to other nations Reuters

items.title: US tells election officials to be on guard against AI-powered tricks ahead of midterms
items.summary: US authorities warned election officials to guard against AI-powered deception techniques ahead of the midterm elections.

items.title: Enterprise AI Enters Risk Management Phase as Security Concerns Rise
items.summary: Dark Reading analysis argues enterprise AI has moved from adoption to execution and risk management as security concerns grow.

items.title: AI Takes Control of Robotic Arm in 16 Minutes Flat
items.summary: Dark Reading reports research in which AI took control of a robotic arm within 16 minutes, underlining the need for faster OT cyber defences on legacy equipment.

items.title: Romanian president calls for greater NATO oversight in the Black Sea in Euronews interview
items.summary: Romania's president calls for stronger NATO oversight in the Black Sea as drone attacks hit commercial vessels off Romania and Bulgaria.

items.title: EU faces growing pressure to plug Ukraine’s Starlink gap
items.summary: The EU faces pressure to replace restricted Starlink connectivity for Ukrainian forces, raising sovereign satellite communications questions.

items.title: Global timekeeping rules change: leap second scrapped from 2027
items.summary: Global timekeepers voted to scrap the leap second from 2027, citing risks to computer systems and the prospect of a negative leap second.

items.title: Managing open-weight model risk in enterprise deployments
items.summary: Microsoft and NVIDIA published a whitepaper offering a shared taxonomy, evaluations and controls for managing open-weight AI model risk in enterprises.

items.title: Cybersecurity incident at BAE Systems disrupts US bankruptcy court system
items.summary: A cybersecurity incident at BAE Systems has halted nationwide US bankruptcy court notices since 9 October, with no cause or restoration date disclosed.

items.title: When Your Ransomware Negotiator Works for the Other Side
items.summary: The arrest of a known ransomware negotiator accused of working with attackers highlights the need for oversight of incident response vendors.

items.title: Key Practices for Incident Readiness and Response in Super Intelligence Training and Evaluation
items.summary: NIST, NSA's Super Intelligence Security Center and CISA published ten voluntary core practices for incident readiness and response when training and evaluating high-risk advanced AI agents.

items.title: Norwegian DPA fines Xandr EUR 8 600 000 for unlawful processing of personal data
items.summary: The Norwegian DPA fined adtech firm Xandr (now part of Microsoft) EUR 8.6 million for unlawful processing of personal data, including special categories, in online advertising.

items.title: Small Agents, Smaller Blast Radius: Controlling What AI Can Do, (Fri, Oct 16th)
items.summary: SANS ISC argues for limiting AI agent capabilities to shrink blast radius rather than treating AI security as a monolithic problem.

items.title: Notes from the IAPP Canada: Government funding initiative supports responsible AI adoption
items.summary: IAPP reports on a Canadian government funding initiative supporting responsible AI adoption.

items.title: A view from DC: Time is running out to prepare for privacy audits
items.summary: IAPP commentary warns US organisations that time is running out to prepare for upcoming privacy audits.

items.title: Sweden sweeps the winning title of the European Cybersecurity Challenge
items.summary: Sweden won the European Cybersecurity Challenge organised by ENISA.

items.title: Trump waives several Russia sanctions as new US law takes effect
items.summary: President Trump waived parts of a new US law imposing sanctions on Russia, citing national interest.

items.title: Trump waives Russia sanctions as rift with Zelenskyy widens
items.summary: Trump waived further Russia sanctions to ease energy prices as the rift with President Zelenskyy widens.

items.title: Trump puts on hold new Russia sanctions he signed into law
items.summary: Trump placed newly signed Russia sanctions on hold via executive order, days before the sanctions deadline.

items.title: Albania’s PM blames ‘foreign hands’ for protests
items.summary: Albania's prime minister blamed 'foreign hands' for months of protests in the country.

items.title: Trump waives key Russia-related sanctions, tariffs before they take effect under new law
items.summary: Trump waived key Russia-related sanctions and tariffs before they took effect under new US legislation.

items.title: Trump 'completely wrong' to restrict support for Ukraine, Italian minister tells BBC
items.summary: Italy's defence minister told the BBC that Trump is 'completely wrong' to restrict support for Ukraine, warning it may prolong the war.

items.title: Anthropic quietly pitches its own AI safety bill to lawmakers, Politico reports
items.summary: Politico reports that Anthropic has been quietly pitching its own AI safety legislation to US lawmakers.

items.title: Quoting Addy Osmani, Morgan Westlee Lunt, and Qing Wang
items.summary: Commentary on shifting code review from a human gate at PR time to continuous AI-assisted review, with humans focusing on higher-level risk questions.

items.title: EU leaders clash over migration, Ukraine and budget in Brussels — but delay big decisions
items.summary: EU leaders clashed over migration, Ukraine funding and the long-term budget in Brussels, deferring key decisions to November and December summits.

items.title: Budget, Ukraine, migration: Five takeaways from the EU leaders’ summit
items.summary: Takeaways from the EU summit: no budget deal, a €70bn Ukraine funding gap, clashes on energy and migration, and plans for new trade defence tools.

items.title: Albanian PM blames 'foreign hands' for escalating anti-government unrest
items.summary: Albania's PM blamed foreign interference for anti-government unrest; police detained 160 people after violence.

items.title: US federal bankruptcy court operations disrupted by cybersecurity incident
items.summary: A cybersecurity incident has disrupted operations of the US federal bankruptcy court system.

items.title: Proofpoint lines up $6.3 billion deal for Varonis’ data security
items.summary: Proofpoint announced a $6.3 billion all-cash acquisition of data security vendor Varonis.

items.title: Employees using personal ChatGPT at work? Here's what IT admins need to do
items.summary: Sponsored guidance on detecting and controlling employee use of personal ChatGPT accounts at work to prevent sensitive data exposure.

items.title: Zelenskyy warns 20M Ukrainians could flee to Europe if Russia wins war
items.summary: Zelenskyy warned that up to 20 million Ukrainians could flee to Europe if Russia wins the war, as Kyiv faces a winter cash crunch.
